nodes.text:
🔹 Common Symptoms
Most people experience mild symptoms like a cough or cold.

🔹 Rare Severe Cases
•Severe illness is uncommon but can occur in young infants, requiring hospitalization and oxygen.

nodes.author: sustainme_in
nodes.text:
•In extremely rare cases, it may lead to severe pneumonia, necessitating ICU care and respiratory support.

🔹 Prevention
✔️ Practice respiratory hygiene, such as covering coughs and sneezes, regular handwashing, and avoiding touching the face.
